sentences.en: The brightest student expressed gratitude on behalf of his classmates.
sentences.zh: 班上最聪明的学生代表同学们向你们表示感谢。

sentences.en: I bought a new dress for her on his behalf.
sentences.zh: 我给他买了一件新裙子。

sentences.en: I am writing to you on behalf of my mother.
sentences.zh: 我是代表我妈妈写这封信的。

mnemonic: 联想记忆：be（使…）+half（半）→使两半，一变二，当然生利→利益

collocations.en: on behalf of/ on one’s behalf
